description:
Configure VAT tax codes for the Northwind Traders business in Manager.io. 

Starting from the Summary dashboard, navigate to the 'Settings' module and find the 'Tax Codes' section. 

Create two new tax codes with the following exact details:
1. Name: 'UK Standard Rate', Rate: 20%
2. Name: 'UK Reduced Rate', Rate: 5%

Ensure both tax codes are saved and visible in the Tax Codes list.
